participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Stayed at the back. He did not speak.

participation.context: Was told to be still, and said he could.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

story.body: You heard the lower pitch, preferred it, and struck no word. Nick kept the trick. Sam was told to stand still. Arthur's silence was left as silence.

title: Heard Juliet set a third under the note

description: Two titles, and not his afternoon

participation.context: Read the two titles, and left.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read both titles at the Theatre and went home. You did not stay for Richard III, and you did not cross.

title: Read Richard III and Wonder of a Woman, and went home
